title: Review lens selector output
description: Output of the lens selector agent: which review lenses should run for this scope, and an optional dimension decomposition for large scopes.

lenses.description: Selected lenses. Empty or invalid selection triggers the all-lenses fallback in the orchestrator.

name.description: Lens slug — must match the concern_slug enum in agent-output.schema.json.

rationale.description: One line grounded in what the scope actually touches.

dimensions.description: Optional decomposition for large scopes. Omit for small scopes — the orchestrator defaults to a single full-scope dimension.

name.description: Short human-readable dimension name, e.g. "auth subsystem".

scope.description: What the dimension covers, e.g. {"paths": ["src/auth/"]} or {"theme": "all CLI entry points"}. Set "shared_infrastructure": true when the dimension covers shared code (core/, lib/, shared utils) changed alongside feature files — its agents then only report issues introduced or exposed by the change.
